children: ANTIN INFRASTRUCTURE PARTNERS ANNOUNCES PLACEMENT OF ANTIN SHARES BY A GROUP OF CURRENT AND FORMER PARTNERS
FOLLOWING SALE, ANTIN'S FREE FLOAT INCREASED BY C.2.9 MILLION SHARES, FROM 15.8% TO 17.5% OF ITS OUTSTANDING SHARE CAPITAL
SELLERS SOLD 5.0 MILLION ORDINARY SHARES, REPRESENTING 2.8% OF ANTIN'S CAPITAL, AT A PRICE OF EUR 7.18 PER SHARE
SOME MEMBERS OF EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE, INCLUDING ALAIN RAUSCHER, CHAIRMAN AND CEO, PURCHASED C.1.4 MILLION SHARES AT OFFERING PRICE
